This is so unserious 😭🌹👄 Full guide: A lot of people ask me how to become a model. Polas, also called digitals, are simple, unedited photos that show a model’s natural look. They’re taken in good lighting, usually wearing plain clothes, with no makeup or filters. Agencies use polas to see a model’s real proportions, bone structure, and overall appearance without styling or retouching. They’re essential for castings, agency submissions, and keeping a model’s portfolio up to date. Don't get scammed !!! A serious agency never asks you for money to apply, for castings or for taking polas! Be cautious ⚠️ #model #howtobecomeamodel #mogger #mogged #FYP
